build.summary:
I built diag-lab-drugs, which turns drug orders in the diagnostic lab into syringe actions. All the acceptance tests run without a browser pass, and the typecheck is clean.

What the learner gets:
- **A Drugs tab** (`DrugsTab.tsx`). It shows the systolic pressure on the monitor (line or cuff) and the time since the last vasodilator, and gives no dose advice. The drug menu offers only doses stated in the module text, each with its source, plus a free "Other" dose. Each order can go through the manifold, as a needle through the Y-connector, through the sheath side arm, or be given by the team (IV or IM). Each syringe waiting on the table has a Give button. The tab also has the team's read-back lines with a Correct button, an "Ask about PDE-5 inhibitors" button, a short order log, and a reminder before the first nitrate that is hidden in exams. A small cut-out of the table shows the syringe.
- **A session module** (`modules/drugs.ts`), offered to the tab as the 'drugs' capability. It records every order with the systolic pressure at the time it was ordered. Orders go through the team, which reads them back. IC and IA syringes are drawn up and put on the table for the operator. IV and IM drugs and saline are given by the team. Without a team (tests) doses are given directly.
  - It raises 'vasodilator-given' for 300 s of lab time after IC or IA GTN or IA verapamil.
  - It holds 'pde5-recent' for the case when the chart's PDE-5 inhibitor is inside its window.
  - It starts a nitrate infusion written on the chart already at its steady state, so an IC bolus has a smaller effect.
  - IA lidocaine is refused with the seizure warning.
- **Attending checks before a drug goes in** (`src/mentor/rules/diagDrugs.ts`). Before the operator gives an IC or IA syringe ('give-ic') and before the team is asked to give a drug ('give'), five checks run:
  - an IC drug through a damped or ventricularised trace
  - IA lidocaine
  - a nitrate with one of the module text's cautions (PDE-5 window, RV infarction, hypovolaemia, obstructive HCM)
  - an antiarrhythmic flagged by the formulary (long QT, pre-excited AF, unpaced high-grade block, poor LV)
  - an IC nitrate above Brilakis's dose ladder for the systolic, or more nitrate into a falling pressure (a technique check, left to the debrief in independent mode)

  When a check stops an action, the line sends the learner back to the chart, ECG or pressure without naming the planted problem.
- **Team and table support.** `labTeam.ts` gained order, fluid, read-back confirmation, syringe hand-off, decline and the PDE-5 question (the patient answers from the engine's patient). `TableView.tsx` gained an optional drug syringe on the manifold, Y-connector or sheath, and an option to show only that part of the table. `patient.ts` gained two helpers: one lists a patient's nitrate cautions, the other reads a nitrate infusion rate off the chart.
- **Four scenarios** (`diagnosticScenarios/drugs.ts` and `drugs.launch.ts`):
  - diag-nitrate-dose-by-pressure: a small non-dominant RCA. A deep JR seat with a ventricularised or damped trace raises 'ostial-spasm'.
  - diag-pde5-patient: tadalafil 30 h ago, inside its 48 h window.
  - diag-nitrate-hypotension: an inferior STEMI with RV involvement after thrombolysis.
  - diag-nitrate-on-infusion: a GTN infusion at 50 µg/min.

One design change: I rebuilt diag-nitrate-hypotension as a post-thrombolysis case with a severe RCA narrowing. The first version had an acute thrombotic occlusion. At the default seed ("1") its seeded STEMI patient had no culprit, so an existing check in scenarios.test.ts failed (the lab session builds that patient, and it is not my file).

acceptance.criterion: GTN 200 ug IC lowers systolic within 90 s; with a PDE-5 inhibitor 4 h earlier the fall is larger; phenylephrine reverses it
acceptance.evidence: drugs.test.ts 'the patient's response' uses diag-nitrate-dose-by-pressure at seed 1. GTN 200 µg IC through the module (independent mode) lowers the true aortic systolic by more than 1.5 mmHg in 90 s (prototype run: about 3 mmHg). The same patient with sildenafil 4 h earlier falls more than 2 mmHg further (about 9 mmHg). The attending stops that dose with 'nitrate-caution', so the test gives it straight to the engine, as an override would. Phenylephrine 100 µg IV through the module then lifts the systolic more than 3 mmHg above the low point and above an untreated twin within 60 s.

- **What needs a browser:** only criterion 4 (read-back, pressure fall and dose tip in the live lab). The other five are covered by vitest.
- **Out-of-scope dependencies:** the main table strip shows no syringe until Simulator.tsx passes the new prop. The drug checks stay out of the live attending until context.ts, useAttending.ts and mentor.test.ts change.
- **Sources:** every dose, threshold and source in the new code is cited to the module text (mostly src/content/manual/pci-manual/04-lab-drugs.ts, with line numbers) or labelled MODEL PARAMETER in code comments. I could not add entries to docs/realism/facts because that file is not in this package.
- **Pharmacology:** no drug was added and pharmacology.ts is unchanged. Doses go through engine.giveDrug and engine.give, and the existing interaction table (pde5-nitrate, nitrate-infusion-blunts-bolus, the antiarrhythmic flags).
- **Shared engines keep their defaults:** patient.ts only gained pure helpers. The nitrate infusion is applied only when a case chart lists one, by snapshotting and restoring the engine once at the start.
- **Request coverage:** pm-lab-drugs#8 (P2) is covered only in part. Amiodarone is on the menu and the antiarrhythmic stop exists. The VT, AF and SVT events, defibrillation and pacing orders are not built.

review.verdict:
The package needs changes before it is accepted. Most of it is complete and sourced. Both package test files pass (26 tests), and every cited module-text line I checked matches its claim (04-lab-drugs.ts 251/254/256/260/308-312/321-322/429/650/788-789/1152/1352/2108, 07-engaging.ts:1321, 05-access.ts:816, 05-patient-complications.ts:261, 09-interpreting.ts:1137/1139). The snapshot diffs of TableView.tsx, labTeam.ts and patient.ts only add code: with no `drug` prop the table renders exactly as before, and generatePatient and the engine defaults are unchanged. No file under src changed since .started outside the package list unless it belongs to a concurrent package (transseptal, teer, pciBench, bifurcation, access, structural, caseSession: none mention drugs).

Typecheck: `npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` exits 2. All 13 errors are in src/ui/lab/structuralTips.transseptal.test.ts, which belongs to another package. There are none in this package's files.

controls.test.ts fails 2 tests. Both 'pci-devices' (another package) and this package's new 'drugs' tab cause it, as the builder reported.

I ran a scratch session with the team switched on, which no package test does. The full path works: order, read-back, syringe on the table, the Give button, the dose going in and 'vasodilator-given'. The same run shows that the team's hand-off picks the newest syringe of the same drug, not the order the learner clicked (finding 1).

There are two design gaps:
- **diag-nitrate-hypotension:** the case cannot show its teaching point. The RV-infarction caution stops every nitrate, and no interaction in the formulary makes the nitrate fall larger in RV infarction.
- **The read-back:** only "Correct" is offered. The learner cannot reject a misheard read-back, and the team proceeds without the confirmation anyway.

The builder's out-of-scope list is accurate: Simulator.tsx prop, PreAction widening, useAttending routing, mentor.test.ts treatment of stop-only rules, controls.test.ts, the tip retargets, and the docs/realism/facts entries.

findings.problem: The Give button on a specific record calls crew.giveSyringe(drug), and team.administer takes the NEWEST syringe of that drug that has not been given. Say two GTN syringes are on the table (100 µg intracoronary through the manifold, then 200 µg intra-arterial through the sheath) and they became ready in order. Clicking Give on the first record runs the attending's give-ic checks on the 100 µg intracoronary dose, but the 200 µg intra-arterial syringe goes into the patient. The first record is marked given while the team's syringe for it stays on the table. My scratch run with the team on showed this depends only on which syringe the team finished first. No test covers the team path through DrugOrders.
findings.fix: In labTeam.ts, change `giveSyringe(drug?: DrugId, orderId?: number): boolean` so that, when orderId is given, it first finds `const st = this.team.st.syringes; const k = st.findIndex((x) => x.orderId === orderId && x.givenAt === undefined); if (k < 0) return false; st.push(st.splice(k, 1)[0]);` (administer takes the newest match) and then `return this.team.administer(drug);`. In drugs.ts give(), call `s.crew.giveSyringe(drug, rec.teamOrderId)`. Add a test to src/ui/sim/drugs.test.ts with `new DiagnosticLabSession(useSimulatorStore, null, null, {})` (the team on works in node). It should order GTN 100 through the manifold and GTN 200 through the sheath, step about 40 s, give the first record, and assert three things: `crew.team.st.syringes.find(x => x.orderId === rec1.teamOrderId).givenAt` is defined, the other syringe has not been given, and 'vasodilator-given' is in tipContext().events.

findings.problem: The scenario cannot show its title's teaching point, 'The pressure falls after nitrate'. In guided, supervised and independent modes the 'nitrate-caution' safety rule always blocks GTN, because the 'rv-infarction' fact comes from drugSetups. And if nitrate is given anyway (exam mode, or the engine directly), nothing in pharmacology.ts or the profile makes the response to a nitrate larger in RV infarction: the interactions are pde5-nitrate, hocm-nitrate and nitrate-infusion. The patient falls only by the ordinary amount, about 3 mmHg for 200 µg in the builder's run. The plan requires that 'Chart contraindications (… RV infarction, hypovolaemia …) change the response through the formulary's interaction table'. The builder reported hypovolaemia and HOCM as unmodelled, but not RV infarction.
findings.fix: Report this to the plan owner as out of scope, because pharmacology.ts and labSession.ts are not package files. One option is an 'rv-infarction-nitrate' interaction, a MODEL PARAMETER gain on the nitrate's preload effect, keyed on a profile flag that profileFromChart sets from the chart or from drugSetups facts. Until that lands, add an outOfScope entry for it. Also add a test in drugs.test.ts that documents the current behaviour (GTN is stopped with 'nitrate-caution', and no interaction flag is raised for RV infarction), so the gap is visible.

findings.problem: gate() builds a throwaway MentorEngine for each check. In independent and exam modes, preAction pushes a technique rule ('nitrate-dose-band') onto engine.deferred and returns allow:true. The engine is then discarded, so the note never reaches the debrief, the telemetry or `this.stops`. The builder's claim that the dose-ladder question is 'left to the debrief in independent mode' is therefore not delivered. A dose above the ladder in independent mode leaves no trace.
findings.fix: After `const r = engine.preAction(...)`, copy `engine.deferred` into a new `readonly deferred: { t: number; ruleId: string; recordId: number }[]` on DrugOrders and emit `this.telemetry("drug.deferred", { recordId: rec.id, rule: d.ruleId })` for each note. Then return r. Also record a non-blocking utterance (allow true with an utterance) in this.stops with telemetry 'drug.flagged'. Add a test: in independent mode, a GTN dose above nitrateDoseLimitUg gives allow true and adds one deferred note with ruleId 'nitrate-dose-band'.

findings.problem: The read-back loop cannot be used for its purpose. The team can mishear a dose by a factor of ten (roles/drugs.ts mishear, P.mishearP). The tab offers only 'Correct', with no way to reject or cancel a read-back. The team draws up and gives the drug whether or not 'Correct' is pressed, so the only safety point of the read-back cannot be exercised from the tab. Also, the operator's own 'Correct.' line never appears in the tab's team lines, because it is not added to `spoken`.
findings.fix: Add `cancelLast(): void { this.team.intent({ raw: "No, cancel that.", intent: { k: "cancel" } }, "button"); }` to LabTeam (labTeam.ts), and `reject()` to DrugsCapability and DrugOrders. reject() should call it, add the raw text to `spoken`, and set the matching record's status to 'declined' once the team reports the order cancelled (check teamStatus === 'cancelled' in teamStatus/onTeamEvents). Show a 'No, cancel' button beside 'Correct' in the tab. In confirm(), add "Correct." to `this.spoken`.

findings.problem: Every DiagnosticLabSession in both files is built with { team: false }. The path the browser criterion depends on is never tested: DrugOrders through the crew (order, then 'team.syringe-ready' setting the record on-table, then give through the crew setting it given, then the engine's 'drug.given' raising vasodilator-given, then lines() showing the read-back). The reachability test also asserts only `a.length <= b.length`, while the acceptance requires the waiting count to fall by at least the number of entries that name diag-lab-drugs.
findings.fix: Add a test with the team on (`new DiagnosticLabSession(useSimulatorStore, null, null, {})`). It should order GTN 100 through the manifold, assert that m.lines() contains '100 micrograms of GTN intracoronary', step until m.onTable().length === 1, give, and assert record status 'given' and 'vasodilator-given' in the events. Combine it with the two-syringe case from finding 1. In modules/drugs.test.ts, change the count assertion to `expect(b.length - a.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(mine.length)`.

findings.problem: The reminder 'Before the first nitrate: PDE-5 inhibitors asked about, and the echo checked for outflow tract obstruction.' is hidden only in exam mode, so it also shows in independent mode. Under the plan's rule it is a guided aid, and independent mode should not show it.
findings.fix: Pass the mode down and render it only when `mode === "guided" || mode === "supervised"`: `{(mode === "guided" || mode === "supervised") && !anyNitrate && …}`. Extend the render test so `html("independent")` does not contain 'Before the first nitrate' and `html("guided")` does.

findings.problem: `VIA_LABEL[r.via].toLowerCase()` turns 'Needle through the Y-connector' into 'needle through the y-connector' in the syringe chips and the order log.
findings.fix: Add a lower-case map instead of calling toLowerCase(): `const VIA_INLINE: Record<DrugVia, string> = { manifold: "through the manifold", "y-connector": "needle through the Y-connector", sheath: "sheath side arm", team: "team gives" };` and use VIA_INLINE[r.via] in both places.

findings.problem:
Small rendering costs:
- useSyncExternalStore receives a new inline subscribe function on every render, so React unsubscribes and resubscribes every second (the 1 Hz tick).
- The inset TableView gets a new `state` object literal on every render, which reruns its `base` useMemo.
- Because that state has no `syringe`, the inset starts TableView's idle preview requestAnimationFrame loop. That loop runs every frame while the syringe inset is visible.
findings.fix: Use `const sub = useCallback((fn: () => void) => cap.subscribe(fn), [cap]);` and pass `sub`. Hoist the inset state to a module constant that includes an empty syringe, so TableView's preview loop is skipped (hostSyringe true): `const INSET_STATE = { setup: "diagnostic", present: ["sheath", "catheter"], syringe: <the host empty-syringe shape TableView accepts> } as const;`.

findings.problem:
Two unlabelled numbers:
- The thresholds that phrase the patient's answer (under 12 h 'about N hours ago', under 36 h 'yesterday') carry no MODEL PARAMETER label.
- The GTN menu offers 50 µg through the sheath, but the cited source gives only 100-200 µg intra-arterial (Brilakis, 04-lab-drugs.ts:256). The menu's doses are per drug, not per route.
findings.fix: Name the thresholds `MP_PDE5_ANSWER_HOURS = { recentH: 12, yesterdayH: 36 }`, with a comment marking them as a MODEL PARAMETER for display phrasing only, and add them to the builder's docs/realism/facts outOfScope list. Give DrugMenuEntry an optional `dosesByVia?: Partial<Record<DrugVia, readonly number[]>>`, with `sheath: [100, 200]` for GTN, and have the tab use `entry.dosesByVia?.[viaNow] ?? entry.doses`.

fix.notes:
I verified all nine findings against the code and applied each one. I only edited the package's own files.

1. Wrong syringe given (major). Confirmed: team.administer takes the newest unused syringe of a drug. `LabTeam.giveSyringe(drug?, orderId?)` now finds the syringe drawn up for that order and moves it last for the administer call. It then puts the syringe back in its old position, so syringesOnTable() still lists oldest first. `DrugOrders.give()` passes `rec.teamOrderId`. New team-on test: GTN 100 µg through the manifold and 200 µg through the sheath. Giving record 1 uses syringe 1 only. Record 2 stays on the table. Record 1 is marked given, and 'vasodilator-given' is raised.

2. No RV infarction effect on the nitrate response (major). Confirmed, and out of scope: the fix needs `src/simulation/patient/pharmacology.ts` and the profile/labSession code, which are not package files. Proposed change for the plan owner: add an 'rv-infarction-nitrate' interaction, a MODEL PARAMETER gain on the nitrate's preload effect, keyed on a profile flag that profileFromChart sets from the chart or from the drugSetups facts. Until then, diag-nitrate-hypotension cannot show its title ("The pressure falls after nitrate") beyond the ordinary fall. Hypovolaemia and HOCM need the same work. A new test records the current behaviour: GTN is stopped with 'nitrate-caution', and engine.interactionFlags('gtn') has no RV flag.

3. Deferred notes lost (major). Confirmed: the throwaway MentorEngine dropped them. gate() is still a pure check, and the tests call it directly. A new private `ask()` runs on real actions (give, the 'give' path, IA lidocaine):
   - each deferred note goes into a new `DrugOrders.deferred` list, with telemetry 'drug.deferred';
   - a non-blocking utterance (an exam's logged stop) goes into `stops`, with telemetry 'drug.flagged'.
   New test: in independent mode, a dose above the ladder is given, and one 'nitrate-dose-band' note is recorded. Calling gate() alone records nothing.

4. No way to reject a read-back (minor). Confirmed. I used the team's 'negate' intent rather than 'cancel', because negate is the real read-back rejection: the team logs a misheard dose as caught and asks again. `LabTeam.rejectReadback()` sends "No, that's not right." inside the acknowledgement window, or "Cancel that." after it, and returns the line it used.
   - `DrugsCapability.reject()` and `DrugOrders.reject()` add that line to `spoken` and mark the record 'declined' once its team order is cancelled. The same check runs on 'team.command' events, so a typed "no" or "cancel" works too.
   - The tab has a "No, cancel" button beside "Correct".
   - `confirm()` now adds "Correct." to `spoken`. Both are tested with the team on.

5. Team path untested (minor). Applied: two team-on tests, described in 1 and 4. The reachability check is now `expect(b.length - a.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(mine.length)`. The count goes from 16 to 14, against 1 entry naming this package.

6. Reminder shown in independent mode (minor). Applied: the tab takes the mode, and the reminder shows only in guided and supervised. The render test checks independent and exam (hidden) and guided and supervised (shown).

7. Lower-cased connector name (minor). Applied: a `VIA_INLINE` map is used in the chips and the order log, so the text reads "needle through the Y-connector". Tested.

8. Rendering costs (minor). Applied:
   - subscribe is wrapped in useCallback;
   - the inset state is a module constant (`INSET_STATE`, typed `Partial<TableState>`);
   - that state includes an empty host syringe, so TableView's preview requestAnimationFrame loop is skipped.

9. Unlabelled numbers (minor). Applied:
   - `MP_PDE5_ANSWER_HOURS = { recentH: 12, yesterdayH: 36 }` in labTeam.ts, labelled as a MODEL PARAMETER for display phrasing only;

fix2.notes:
I applied four of the six findings: 1, 2, 5 and 6. I rejected 3 and 4 because the fixes belong in files outside this package; they are reported for their owners in `rejected`. The six test files above pass and the typecheck is clean.

**Finding 1: syringes stuck on the table** (`src/ui/sim/modules/drugs.ts`, `src/ui/lab/labTeam.ts`, `DrugsTab.tsx`)
- A new `discard(recordId?)` takes a syringe off the table. It marks the record declined with the note 'Discarded by the operator.' With no id it takes the newest syringe.
- With a team, the module calls a new `LabTeam.discardSyringe(orderId)`. This removes the team's prepared syringe, logs the operator line 'Discard that syringe.' and emits `team.syringe-discarded`.
- `reject()` now discards the newest syringe on the table when no team order is open (none in read-back, query or drawing up). Otherwise it cancels the order as before.
- `tableSyringe()` and a bare `give()` now use the newest syringe on the table instead of the oldest.
- `DrugsTab` has a ghost Discard button next to each Give.
- A syringe the attending stops stays on the table until the learner gives or discards it.

**Finding 2: misheard dose given without a stop** (`src/mentor/rules/diagDrugs.ts`)
- New rule `dose-outside-module-range` for both checks, 'give-ic' and 'give'. It is placed before `nitrate-dose-band`. Its stop line is 'Stop. Read the syringe label against your order.'
- `DrugAction` now carries `orderedDose` and `statedMaxDose`. `statedMaxDose` is the largest dose the menu offers for that drug and route (`menuDoses`). Records keep `orderedDose` apart from `dose`, the amount actually drawn up.
- The rule stops when the dose in the syringe is above both the order and `statedMaxDose`. A dose the operator chose, from the menu or typed as Other, never trips it. I used this instead of tracking whether Other was typed: it covers the same cases with less state.
- Severity is technique, as the finding specified. That means it blocks in guided and supervised modes and goes to the debrief in independent and exam modes. If a tenfold dose should also block in independent mode, the severity can be changed to safety.
- Limit: a drug the team gives IV or IM is checked once, when it is ordered. A misheard dose confirmed afterwards is not stopped by this rule; the team debrief already logs it as 'misheard-dose-given'.

**Finding 5: Correct and No, cancel shown with nothing to answer** (`DrugsTab.tsx`)
- Correct shows only while a read-back or team query is waiting (new `readbackPending()`).
- No, cancel shows while a team order is still open, including one being drawn up (new `teamOrderOpen()`). Hiding it during drawing up, as the finding asked, would have removed the only way to cancel such an order from the tab, so I kept it visible then.

**Finding 6: order log on lab time** (`drugs.ts`, `DrugsTab.tsx`)
- Each record now stores the team's clock when it is ordered (`clock`). The order log shows that clock, matching the team lines, and falls back to lab time only without a team.

**Tests** (`src/ui/sim/drugs.test.ts`): four new tests cover discarding with and without a team, newest-first give and table view, `reject()` discarding, the new rule in each mode (including a typed Other dose not tripping it), and the Correct button and team clock in the tab. The existing rule-list expectation now includes the new rule id.
